A group of Lego minifigures, known as the Master Builders, have the ability to build things without instructions. They are shown to gather in the "Dog" section of Cloud Cuckoo Land to discuss various matters. Their creative ways led Lord Business to form the Super Secret Police to hunt them down, resulting in their capture and placement in Kragle tubes.

In Tamil literature, there are texts that mention a group of saints known as the Alvars, who were devoted to the god Vishnu. In medieval era artworks and texts on dancing Shiva found in Nepal, Assam, and Bengal, he is sometimes depicted as dancing on his vahana (animal vehicle) Nandi, the bull, and is known regionally as Narteshvara.

There is research that suggests that preschool may have detrimental effects on social development and cooperation. Additionally, the home environment has been found to have a greater impact on future outcomes than preschool. Emerging evidence also indicates that high-quality preschools are "play based," rather than attempting to provide early formal instruction in academic subjects.

In the television show "Breaking Bad," the characters Walter White and Jesse Pinkman use an RV to cook methamphetamine. In one episode, Walt and Jesse find themselves hiding in the RV from Walt's brother-in-law, Hank Schrader, who is a DEA agent. Walt and Jesse manage to evade Hank by hiding in the RV at a junkyard. Walt gives instructions to Jesse to prevent Hank from entering the RV legally and gets his former student, Saul Goodman, to lure Hank away from the RV.
